title_en: Tieling Heating Equipment Factory v. Zhou Chengfu and Tieling Telecommunication Bureau — dispute over infringement of right to name
keywords_en: Civil; Dispute over Right to Name; First Instance; Basic People's Court; Liaoning Province; Legal Person; Natural Person; General Principles of the Civil Law; Determination of Infringement of Right to Name; Validity of Acts After Change of Legal Representative; Duty of Review of Telecommunications Bureau; Unauthorized Alteration of Telephone Number; Telephone Directory Advertisement; Change of Legal Representative; Dispute over Infringement of Right to Name by Tieling City Telecommunications Bureau
full_text_en:
Tieling City Heating Equipment Factory v. Zhou Chengfu, Tieling City Telecommunications Bureau — Dispute over Infringement of the Right to Corporate Name

Plaintiff: Liaoning Province Tieling City Heating Equipment Factory. Domicile: Yaobu Village, Yaobu Town, Tieling County, Liaoning Province.
Legal Representative: Zhao Fu'an, Factory Director of the said factory.
Agent ad litem: Niu Chunbao, Lawyer of Liaoning Province Tieling Guozhi Law Firm.

Defendant: Zhou Chengfu, male, 57 years old, Factory Director of Liaoning Province Tieling Wenjiao Boiler Factory, residing at Yaobu Village, Yaobu Town, Tieling County, Liaoning Province.
Agent ad litem: Zheng Guichen and Lu Chengzhong, Lawyers of Liaoning Province Tieling Fuzhou Law Firm.

Defendant: Liaoning Province Tieling City Telecommunications Bureau. Domicile: Gongren Street, Yinchou District, Tieling City, Liaoning Province.
Legal Representative: Wang Qiwei, Director of the said Bureau.
Agent ad litem: Jiang Yang, Legal Counsel of Liaoning Province Tieling City Telecommunications Bureau.

Defendant: Liaoning Province Tieling City Postal and Telecommunications Information Directory Company. Domicile: Gongren Street, Yinchou District, Tieling City, Liaoning Province.
Legal Representative: Fu Shulan, Manager of the said company.

Third Party: Cao Yajun, male, 36 years old, farmer, residing at Yaobu Village, Yaobu Town, Tieling County, Liaoning Province.

Third Party: Zhou Yongchang, male, 30 years old, employee of Liaoning Province Tieling City Electric Power Bureau, residing at Yinchou District, Tieling City, Liaoning Province.

Third Party: Liaoning Province Tieling City Tienan Fuel Sales Center. Domicile: Tieling City Economic Development Zone, Liaoning Province.
Legal Representative: Li Xiaodong, Manager of the said center.

The plaintiff, Liaoning Province Tieling City Heating Equipment Factory (hereinafter referred to as the Heating Equipment Factory), filed an action with the Tieling County People's Court, Liaoning Province, against the defendants Zhou Chengfu, Liaoning Province Tieling City Telecommunications Bureau (hereinafter referred to as the Municipal Telecommunications Bureau), and Liaoning Province Tieling City Postal and Telecommunications Information Directory Company (hereinafter referred to as the Directory Company) for a dispute over infringement of the right to corporate name.

Plaintiff's Allegations: The defendant Zhou Chengfu, without the plaintiff's permission, unilaterally altered the plaintiff's telephone numbers in the telephone directory, thereby infringing upon the plaintiff's right to corporate name. The defendant Municipal Telecommunications Bureau and the defendant Directory Company, as the publishers of the said telephone directory, failed to properly examine Zhou Chengfu's alteration of the telephone numbers, resulting in the occurrence of the infringement. They should also bear civil liability for this. The plaintiff requests the court to order all defendants to cease the infringement; immediately transfer to the plaintiff for its use the telephone and pager numbers published under the plaintiff's name but actually controlled and used by the defendant Zhou Chengfu and the third parties in this case; order Zhou Chengfu to make an apology to the plaintiff; and order the three defendants to compensate the plaintiff for economic losses of over RMB 50,000 caused by the infringement.

Defendant Zhou Chengfu's Defense: Since its establishment in 1986, the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory has always had me as its legal representative. In March 1998, the shareholders and the factory's leadership team decided that I should separate from the factory to produce boilers on my own, but I remained a shareholder and legal representative of the factory, sharing the same boiler production license with the factory. Therefore, when the defendant Municipal Telecommunications Bureau verified with me whether the telephone numbers in the advertisement had changed, I altered the original telephone numbers. This was an act performed in the course of my duties and does not constitute infringement.

Defendant Municipal Telecommunications Bureau's Defense: Since the defendant Zhou Chengfu was the legal representative of the plaintiff when the agreement to publish the plaintiff's telephone number advertisement was signed, when publishing the 1999 edition of the China Yellow Pages Tieling Telephone Directory, our bureau contacted Zhou Chengfu to verify whether the telephone numbers had changed. Our bureau was unaware that the plaintiff's legal representative had been replaced, and Zhou Chengfu did not state that he was no longer the plaintiff's legal representative when he requested the alteration of the telephone numbers. Our bureau made the alteration upon the client's own request and had no subjective fault. Therefore, it should not bear civil liability for the infringement.

Defendant Directory Company's Defense: The Directory Company held the same defense as the defendant Municipal Telecommunications Bureau.

Third Party Zhou Yongchang's Statement: The defendant Zhou Chengfu requested that my pager number be published in the telephone directory to help him sell boilers, and I agreed. I have no interest whatsoever in the plaintiff. Whether or not I agree to the publication of my pager number is my right and has nothing to do with the plaintiff. I do not agree to transfer my pager number to the plaintiff for its use.

Third Parties Cao Yajun and Tieling City Tienan Fuel Sales Center (hereinafter referred to as the Fuel Center): Did not provide statements of defense.

Basic Facts Found by the Tieling County People's Court:

The defendant Zhou Chengfu was originally a shareholder and factory director of the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory. He left the Heating Equipment Factory in March 1998 to produce boilers on his own. From April 20, 1998, Hou Shanmin served as the factory director of the Heating Equipment Factory, and on May 27 of the following year, Zhao Fu'an succeeded him as factory director.

On April 24, 1997, the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory entered into an agreement with the defendant Municipal Telecommunications Bureau, stipulating that the Municipal Telecommunications Bureau would publish an advertisement for the Heating Equipment Factory introducing its products and contact information in a 2/3 color insert page in the Tieling Telephone Directory. In April 1999, the Municipal Telecommunications Bureau prepared to publish the China Yellow Pages Tieling Telephone Directory and contacted the defendant Zhou Chengfu to verify whether the content of the advertisement for the Heating Equipment Factory had changed. Without the knowledge of the Heating Equipment Factory, Zhou Chengfu, in the name of the Heating Equipment Factory, requested that the content of the original advertisement, which read "Factory Director: Zhou Chengfu, Tel (Factory): 0410-8857074, (Home): 0410-8857757; Sales Manager: Ma Kai, Pager: 128-7558143; Sales Office: Inside the Metallurgical Warehouse Yard, East of the Roundabout at the West End of the South Ring Railway Overpass, Yinchou District, Tieling City, Tel: 4849149" be amended to "Factory Director: Zhou Chengfu, Tel: 0410-8858484, 0410-8857757 (Home), Mobile: 1394907670; Sales Manager: Cao Yajun, Tel: 8857848 (Home), Pager: 129-7559523; Sales Office: 10 Meters North of the Main Gate of the Tienan Coal Market, Yinchou District, Tieling City, Tel: 2654624, Contact Person: Zhou Fengying". The Municipal Telecommunications Bureau verified the telephone or pager numbers proposed by Zhou Chengfu for modification by telephone and then published them in the 1999 edition of the China Yellow Pages Tieling Telephone Directory, which was publicly released on June 3 of the same year.

In April 1999, the business telephone numbers used by the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory were "8857074 and 8858497". The telephone numbers "8858484 and 8857757" are now used by the defendant Zhou Chengfu. The mobile number "1394907670" was originally used by Zhang Chunyou and was later transferred by Zhang to Zhou Chengfu. The telephone number "8857848" is now used by the third party Cao Yajun. The pager number "129-7559523" is now used by the third party Zhou Yongchang. The telephone number "2654624" is now used by the third party Fuel Center.

The third parties Cao Yajun and Zhou Yongchang are both sons of the defendant Zhou Chengfu. Cao Yajun is currently selling boilers for Zhou Chengfu. Zhou Chengfu obtained the prior consent of the right holders, Cao Yajun and Zhou Yongchang, before publishing the telephone number "8857848" and the pager number "129-7559523" in the telephone directory. However, Zhou Chengfu published the telephone number "2654624" without first obtaining the consent of the third party Fuel Center.

It was further found that the defendant Directory Company was originally an internal institution of the defendant Municipal Telecommunications Bureau, but it has independent legal personality externally and has the authority to use the telephone directory for advertising; internally, it is not fully independent. The 1999 edition of the China Yellow Pages Tieling Telephone Directory was published by the Municipal Telecommunications Bureau, and over 20,000 copies have been sold.

Since the publication of the 1999 edition of the China Yellow Pages Tieling Telephone Directory, the volume of business calls received by the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory has decreased. In June and July 1999, the book loss of the Heating Equipment Factory amounted to RMB 28,785, whereas in the corresponding periods of 1996, 1997, and 1998, the Heating Equipment Factory had book profits.

The above facts are confirmed by the following evidence:

1. A copy of the business license of the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory, proving that from April 20, 1998, Hou Shanmin was the factory director, and from May 27, 1999, Zhao Fu'an was the factory director.
2. Copies of the Tieling Telephone Directory Advertising Agreement and the original advertisement provided by the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory, proving the content of the advertisement in the original agreement.
3. The draft of the amended advertisement and the color advertisement insert on page eight of the 1999 edition of the China Yellow Pages Tieling Telephone Directory provided by the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory, proving the content of the advertisement amended by the defendant Zhou Chengfu.
4. A copy of the rural telephone receipt for April 1999 provided by the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory, proving the current telephone numbers used by the factory.
5. Certification from Tieling County Telecommunications Bureau that the two telephone numbers "8857757 and 8858484" are used by the defendant Zhou Chengfu, and the telephone number "8857848" is used by the third party Cao Yajun.
6. The statement of the defendant Zhou Chengfu and the certification from witness Zhao Xia provided by the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory, proving that the mobile phone number "139(0)4907570" was originally used by Zhang Chunyou and later transferred to Zhou Chengfu.
7. Certification from Tieling City Post and Telecommunications Bureau that the telephone number "2654624" is used by the third party Fuel Center.
8. The statement of the third party Zhou Yongchang and the certification from witness Tao Jinguang, proving that the pager number "129-7559523" is used by Zhou Yongchang.
9. The statement of the defendant Municipal Telecommunications Bureau and a copy of the advertising business license provided by the defendant Directory Company, proving that from July 1, 1995, to July 1, 1999, the business scope of the Directory Company included designing, producing, and publishing domestic advertisements using the telephone directory it published. The Directory Company was originally an internal institution of the Municipal Telecommunications Bureau; externally, it is an independent legal person enterprise, but internally it is still not fully independent.
10. Testimony of witness Gao Xiaojuan, proving that in April 1999, the defendant Zhou Chengfu amended the draft advertisement of the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory, and the defendant Municipal Telecommunications Bureau verified the amendments by telephone.
11. Copies of the accounting books of the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory for June and July 1999, and accounting statistical reports for June and July of each of the years 1996, 1997, and 1998, and the testimony of witness Hu Zhian, proving the book profit and loss situation of the Heating Equipment Factory and the reasons for the book loss of RMB 28,785 in 1999, which included not only the factor of the altered business telephone numbers but also factors such as enterprise management and market conditions.
12. Testimony of witness Li Tiekui, proving that Zhao Fu'an, Zhou Chengfu, Hou Shanmin, and five others are shareholders of the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory; Zhou Chengfu was originally the factory director and left the factory to produce boilers elsewhere in the spring of 1998; although the shareholders had agreed that Zhou Chengfu could use the Heating Equipment Factory's license to produce boilers, this was not implemented as it did not comply with relevant regulations.
13. Statements of the defendant Zhou Chengfu and the third parties Zhou Yongchang and Cao Yajun, proving that Zhou Yongchang and Cao Yajun are sons of Zhou Chengfu; to help Zhou Chengfu sell boilers, Zhou Yongchang agreed to the publication of his pager number and Cao Yajun agreed to the publication of his telephone number in the Tieling Telephone Directory; Zhou Chengfu did not consult the third party Fuel Center before publishing its telephone number in the Tieling Telephone Directory.

The above evidence, having been cross-examined in court, may serve as the basis for determining the facts of this case.

During the trial, the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory indicated that it waived its claims for an apology from the defendant Zhou Chengfu and for the defendants Municipal Telecommunications Bureau and Directory Company to bear tort liability.

Tieling County People's Court held:

Article 99, paragraph 2, of the General Principles of Civil Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Legal persons, individual businesses, and individual partnerships enjoy the right to corporate name. Enterprise legal persons, individual businesses, and individual partnerships have the right to use and lawfully transfer their own names." Article 120 provides: "If a citizen's right to personal name, portrait, reputation, or honor is infringed upon, he has the right to demand cessation of the infringement, restoration of reputation, elimination of ill effects, an apology, and may also demand compensation for losses." "If a legal person's right to name, reputation, or honor is infringed upon, the provisions of the preceding paragraph shall apply." "Tieling City Heating Equipment Factory" is the registered enterprise name of the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory, which shall be protected by law. No unit or individual may use this name without the permission of the Heating Equipment Factory.

Although the defendant Zhou Chengfu once served as the legal representative of the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory, when he was no longer the legal representative, without the permission of the Heating Equipment Factory, he unilaterally changed the telephone or pager numbers originally under the name of the Heating Equipment Factory to his own telephone numbers or pager numbers that he could use, in order to obtain business information directed to the Heating Equipment Factory, thereby infringing upon the Heating Equipment Factory's right to use its own name. The Heating Equipment Factory's claim for Zhou Chengfu to bear civil liability for the infringement is lawful and shall be upheld.

Article 27 of the Advertising Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Advertising operators and advertising publishers shall, in accordance with laws and administrative regulations, examine relevant certification documents and verify the content of advertisements. For advertisements with untrue content or incomplete certification documents, advertising operators shall not provide design, production, or agency services, and advertising publishers shall not publish them." The defendant Municipal Telecommunications Bureau and the defendant Directory Company are the operators and publishers of the Yellow Pages advertisements in the Tieling Telephone Directory. Before publishing the 1999 edition of the Tieling Telephone Directory, it was appropriate and necessary for the Municipal Telecommunications Bureau and the Directory Company to re-verify the content of the product advertisement that was two years old. However, when conducting the verification, the Municipal Telecommunications Bureau and the Directory Company failed to carefully examine the defendant Zhou Chengfu's official capacity certification documents, nor did they require Zhou Chengfu to produce certification documents from the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory requesting the amendment of the advertisement content. They merely verified the content Zhou Chengfu requested to amend by telephone, thereby failing to fulfill their duty of careful examination, which enabled Zhou Chengfu's infringing act to materialize. For this, the Municipal Telecommunications Bureau and the Directory Company shall bear corresponding civil liability.

The telephone number "8857848" and the pager number "1297559523" are lawfully used by the third parties Cao Yajun and Zhou Yongchang, respectively. Cao Yajun and Zhou Yongchang, as children of the defendant Zhou Chengfu, agreed to have their numbers published in the telephone directory to help Zhou Chengfu sell boilers, without knowing that Zhou Chengfu intended to amend the content of the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory's advertisement. Cao Yajun and Zhou Yongchang had no intention to jointly infringe with Zhou Chengfu and shall not bear civil liability for the infringement.

The defendant Zhou Chengfu, without first consulting the third party Fuel Center, amended and published the telephone number "2654624" in the advertisement content of the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory. The Fuel Center had no knowledge of and was not at fault for this, and shall not bear civil liability for the infringement.

Given that the infringement by the defendant Zhou Chengfu of the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory's right to corporate name, by means of amending the advertisement content in the telephone directory, has become an accomplished fact, measures must be taken to protect the lawful rights and interests of the Heating Equipment Factory. To effectively stop the infringement, it is essential to ensure that the Heating Equipment Factory can receive business information transmitted by telephone following the publication of the telephone directory. Although re-issuing the telephone directory would be an effective measure to stop the infringement, the cost of such a measure in this case would far outweigh the value of the lawful rights and interests that could be protected. Measures taken to resolve civil disputes must be not only fair and equitable but also should, to the extent possible, achieve the protection of lawful rights and interests at a relatively small cost, in line with the principle of pursuing social benefits. In the absence of the possibility of taking remedial action by re-issuing the Tieling Telephone Directory, the Heating Equipment Factory's proposal to have the telephone numbers amended by Zhou Chengfu assigned to it for use is a feasible measure and shall be upheld.

The telephone number "8857757" was a residential telephone number used by the defendant Zhou Chengfu during his tenure as the legal representative of the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory. This telephone number was one that should have been proposed for amendment by the Heating Equipment Factory before the publication of this edition of the Tieling Telephone Directory. Due to Zhou Chengfu's infringing act, the Heating Equipment Factory lost the opportunity to amend it. Zhou Chengfu's retention of this telephone number serves the same purpose as his amendment of the other telephone numbers: both were attempts to obtain business information. Therefore, assigning this telephone number and the mobile number "1394907670" used by Zhou Chengfu to the Heating Equipment Factory for use is part of the civil liability for infringement that Zhou Chengfu shall bear. This claim of the Heating Equipment Factory is reasonable and lawful and shall be upheld. In addition, Zhou Chengfu shall also compensate for the loss in product sales suffered by the Heating Equipment Factory as a result of the amendment of the advertisement content in the Tieling Telephone Directory. Although the Heating Equipment Factory requested compensation based on the factory's operating loss, it is not possible to exclude from that operating loss the losses caused by factors such as poor enterprise management, market conditions, or product quality. Therefore, the amount of compensation shall be determined discretionarily based on the actual circumstances of the case and the principle of fairness and reasonableness. During the proceedings, the Heating Equipment Factory waived its claim for an apology from Zhou Chengfu, which is a disposition of its own civil rights and procedural rights, and shall be approved.

In this case, the third parties Cao Yajun and Zhou Yongchang shall not bear civil liability for the infringement. The telephone number "8857848" and the pager number "1297559523" are numbers lawfully used by them personally. Cao Yajun and Zhou Yongchang, as children of the defendant Zhou Chengfu, agreed to have these two numbers published in the Tieling Telephone Directory only to help Zhou Chengfu sell boilers. If these two numbers are left for continued use by Cao Yajun and Zhou Yongchang, they would face difficulties in handling business information transmitted to the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory through these numbers. If they transmit such information to Zhou Chengfu according to the original arrangement, it would constitute joint infringement with Zhou Chengfu against the Heating Equipment Factory. If they do not transmit it to Zhou Chengfu, such information would become a telephone nuisance to them. Therefore, the assignment of these two numbers to the Heating Equipment Factory for use serves the lawful rights and interests of all parties. Although this may cause loss to Cao Yajun and Zhou Yongchang, who should not bear civil liability for the infringement, such private loss cannot be compared to the social benefits that will arise. Moreover, the loss suffered by Cao Yajun and Zhou Yongchang as a result is a necessary consequence of Zhou Chengfu's infringing act, and they may seek compensation from Zhou Chengfu.

The telephone number "2654624" is a number lawfully used by the third party Fuel Center. The Fuel Center shall not bear civil liability for infringement in this case. As an enterprise legal person, its long-term use of a particular telephone number is closely related to its business performance and constitutes part of its lawful rights and interests. The plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory's request to change the name of the Fuel Center's telephone number and assign it to itself would be unfair to the blameless Fuel Center. Such an approach, sacrificing one lawful right and interest to protect another equal lawful right and interest, cannot be upheld. The fact that the Fuel Center's telephone number has been published under the name of the Heating Equipment Factory creates a certain relationship between the blameless Fuel Center and the reasonable resolution of this case. While the Fuel Center may continue to use this telephone number, it shall bear the obligation not to disclose to Zhou Chengfu any business information concerning the Heating Equipment Factory that it receives by telephone.

During the proceedings, the plaintiff Heating Equipment Factory indicated that it had waived its claims to pursue the defendants Municipal Telecommunications Bureau and Directory Company for tort liability. This is a disposition by the parties of their own civil rights and procedural rights and shall be approved.

The defendant, Zhou Chengfu, argued that he was originally a shareholder and legal representative of the plaintiff, the Heating Equipment Factory, and that after he separated from the factory to produce boilers on his own, he used the same license with the factory's consent through a shareholders' meeting; therefore, his act of changing the telephone number was an official act and did not constitute infringement. Upon investigation, it was found that since April 20, 1998, Zhou Chengfu was no longer the legal representative registered in the business license of the Heating Equipment Factory as a legal person, but was merely one of the shareholders of the factory. Without the permission of the legal person, a shareholder has no right to represent the legal person in external activities. The existing evidence cannot prove that the shareholders' meeting ever allowed Zhou Chengfu to use the same license as the Heating Equipment Factory to produce boilers. Even if this fact could be proven, it would only concern the legality of the procedures for producing boilers, and it cannot be deemed that Zhou Chengfu therefore acquired the rights of a legal representative. This defense of Zhou Chengfu cannot be sustained.

In summary, the Tieling County People's Court rendered the following judgment on September 29, 1999:

1. The defendant, Zhou Chengfu, shall immediately cease the infringement upon the plaintiff, Heating Equipment Factory's right to a name; the ordinary telephone numbers "8858484, 8857757" and the mobile phone number "139(0)4907670" used by Zhou Chengfu, the ordinary telephone number "8857848" used by the third party, Cao Yajun, and the pager number "129-7559523" used by the third party, Zhou Yongchang, shall all belong to the Heating Equipment Factory.

2. The third party, the Fuel Center, shall not convey information regarding sales boiler business received via the telephone number "2654624" to the defendant, Zhou Chengfu.

3. The defendant, Zhou Chengfu, shall compensate the plaintiff, the Heating Equipment Factory, for economic losses in the amount of RMB 3,000.

4. The court permits the plaintiff, the Heating Equipment Factory, to withdraw its claims for an apology from the defendant Zhou Chengfu and for compensation for economic losses from the defendants, the City Telecom Bureau and the Directory Company.

5. The remaining claims of the plaintiff, the Heating Equipment Factory, are dismissed.

The case acceptance fee of RMB 850 shall be borne by the defendant, Zhou Chengfu.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, none of the parties appealed, and the first-instance judgment has become legally effective.
